advice.headline: Make a trade

moves.text: Offer Lava Me Tender: Ja'Kobi Lane + Antonio Williams for Emeka Egbuka.
Pick up Elijah Higgins off waivers (+1.2 points a week) and drop Jalen Nailor.

reasons: You're 13-5 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 27%.
A top-2 seed matters: you win the title 37% of the time with the first-round bye and 20% without it. You get the bye in 38% of seasons right now.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 2nd of 8 contenders (177.5 points a week).
Your weakest position is WR (11th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 1st in 2026, 1st in 2027 and 1st in 2028 (title chances about 27%, 28%, 34%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.

That trade raises your title chance from 27% to 29%, and your lineup comes out 0.8 points a week ahead overall. Ja'Kobi Lane + Antonio Williams add 1.5 points a week for you today, but Emeka Egbuka is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 3,017, get 3,101), and it barely changes their lineup (-0.4 a week).
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 28% and 34% to 28% and 34%.
You have 4 weeks until the trade deadline.
